title: SBMM (Skill Based Minecraft-Making)
description: Do you love playing rigged games? Well then this is the plugin for you!
body:
Are you the type of guy to play and love rigged games like COD? Well, this is the plugin for you! **Bringing the rigged "fun" of COD to Minecraft!** Now, mobs and players become _harder_ to kill the better you get at killing them! It keeps your K/D ratio at an average of 1 and makes the game fair and fun for everyone in the lobby!

_This is a plugin, so it must be installed on a server. Works on 1.16.1 and later, but older versions will come out at some point._ Servers (particularly PaperMC servers) are not hard to set up with a tutorial, so just look up "how to make papermc server 1.21" or something and there should be a guide. Hope you enjoy!
